svg.title: Evaluation scheme
svg.desc: Validity, narrative quality and aggregation, worked on AnimateBanana's alpha masking animation of CVPR_2025_pipe00004: VF A, then ASC B, G = 1; Q_SS 1.0000, Q_GP 0.9722, Q_NA 0.9722; Q_n = AN = 0.9815. Press play on the film reel to run the evaluation.
svg.text: Does the animation correctly realize the source diagram
